prompt: Who is the first Republican president of the United States to serve non-consecutive terms?
answer: **Donald Trump** is the first Republican president to serve nonconsecutive terms. He served as the **45th president (2017–2021)** and returned as the **47th president in 2025**. Grover Cleveland was the first president overall to do so.
